entities.summary: Admiral José de Ribas y Boyons, known in Spanish as José Pascual Domingo de Ribas y Boyons, in Italian as Giuseppe de Ribas and in Russian as Iosif (Osip) Mikhailovich Deribas, was a Spanish military officer under the Spanish held Kingdom of Naples, in Russian service.
